column3: §FILM_FACT bodies · the converted shed, after a short card
column4: M: The same shed. Only what is new.
column5: M: The same shed, {bodies} bodies. | F: Is all of it new? | M: No. Only what changed since the last film. Each one shown, then enlarged.

column3: §FILM_FACT dims_drawn / dim_a_say / dim_b_say · a beam long section on the DETAILS sheet, enlarged
column4: M: Every dimension on the sheet is drawn now: {dims_drawn} here.
column5: M: First, the sheet. Every dimension on your details sheet is drawn now, {dims_drawn} of them, with the diameter sign on the bars. | F: Can we see one up close? | M: A beam long section. The spans, {dim_a_say} and {dim_b_say}, and the bar label.

column3: §FILM_FACT notes_read · the NOTES row of the 2D panel, enlarged
column4: M: A sheet of notes is marked NOTES: {notes_read} read.
column5: M: And a sheet that only carries notes is marked as notes, not as an error. The model read {notes_read} general notes from it.

column3: §FILM_FACT ratio_say / n_ratio_footing / n_ratio_column · the casting-ratio note, enlarged
column4: M: Your note, mix {ratio_say}, is read as a fact.
column5: M: Your own note says the footings, columns and grade beams are cast at {ratio_say}. | F: Does the model use it? | M: Yes. {n_ratio_footing} footings and {n_ratio_column} columns carry that mix, and the mix chooses the price row.

column3: §FILM_FACT gb_mark / gb_tags / gb_bodies · the advisory in the verdict list, enlarged
column4: M: {gb_mark}: tagged and detailed, but not modelled.
column5: M: The checks now compare your tags, your details and the model. The mark {gb_mark} is tagged {gb_tags} times and has a detail, but no body is built for it. | F: Is that an error? | M: No. It is an advisory.

column3: §FILM_FACT gb_tags_on_sheet · the GB-1 tag on the foundation layout, enlarged
column4: M: There is the tag, on your foundation layout.
column5: M: And there is the tag on your foundation layout. The model has nothing under it, and says so.

column3: §FILM_FACT imp_k1_say / imp_o1 / imp_d1 / imp_k2_say / imp_k3_say · Element defaults, Measure impact, the ranked rows enlarged
column5: M: Element defaults, then Measure impact. Pick a rate pack, and measure. | F: What does it show? | M: Every default the model used, ranked by what it moves. First {imp_k1_say}: at {imp_o1} it changes the bill by {imp_d1} taka. Then {imp_k2_say}, then {imp_k3_say}.

column3: §FILM_FACT ls_total_kN / ls_parts · the Load Summary own-weight card, enlarged
column4: M: A ballpark right away: {ls_total_kN} kilonewtons.
column5: M: Export, Load Summary. A quick dead-load estimate, right away: {ls_total_kN} kilonewtons of own weight, in {ls_parts} parts. | F: Is that a design? | M: No. It is a ballpark, until the engineer's analysis.

column3: §FILM_FACT ls_missing_n / ls_unweighed · the red not-stated inputs, enlarged
column4: M: In red: what only an engineer can state.
column5: M: In red, what only an engineer can state: {ls_missing_n} inputs, the soil capacity among them. And {ls_unweighed} parts could not be weighed, and the page says so.

column3: §FILM_FACT soil_typed · the Regulatory Report form, soil typed as an example
column4: M: To hand it in: the report. Soil typed as an example.
column5: M: To hand it in, Export, Regulatory Report. The soil value is typed here only as an example, {soil_typed} kilopascals, the kind of value a soil report gives. | F: And then? | M: Build.

column3: §FILM_FACT rr_cert_line / rr_sig_blank · the not-a-certificate line, enlarged
column4: M: The report says what it is not.
column5: M: The first thing the report says is what it is not: a compliance certificate. It states the facts of the model, and the signature blocks stay blank.

column3: §FILM_FACT sor_a_say / sor_page_a / sor_book · the SoR table, enlarged
column4: M: The concrete is priced at item {sor_a_say}.
column5: M: Remember the mix? The bill prices the footings and columns at item {sor_a_say}, page {sor_page_a} of the {sor_book}. | F: Because of your note? | M: Yes. The drawing's own note picked that row.

column3: §FILM_FACT std_file · Export, Analytical model, the downloaded model.std opened as text, header enlarged
column4: M: And hand on: a starting model for the engineer.
column5: M: Then hand on. Export, Analytical model for STAAD Pro. A plain text file: a starting model for the structural engineer. | F: Is it a design? | M: No. Its first lines say so.

column3: §FILM_FACT st_joints / st_members / st_supports / st_dangling · the JOINT, MEMBER and SUPPORT sections, enlarged
column5: M: Inside, {st_joints} joints, {st_members} members and {st_supports} supports. {st_dangling} member ends join nothing, and they are listed, not hidden.

column4: M: That is what is new.
column5: M: That is what is new.
